Petra Svoboda  
Senior Game Developer | LuminaPlay Studios  
Email: petra.svoboda@luminaplay.com | Phone: +420 123 456 789 | Location: Prague, Czech Republic  

A seasoned game developer with seven years of experience shaping immersive digital experiences across diverse studio environments. Specializing in crafting robust game systems, optimizing 3D graphics pipelines, and architecting scalable physics simulations. Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance games that balance technical complexity with player engagement. My work consistently drives measurable improvements in frame rates, latency reduction, and simulation accuracy, ensuring seamless multiplayer interactions and visually compelling worlds.  

At LuminaPlay Studios, I spearheaded the architecture for a cross-platform puzzle game that achieved a 35% increase in player retention within its first month. My focus on 3D graphics optimization reduced rendering overhead by 22%, enabling real-time lighting adjustments without compromising frame consistency. I also led the integration of a custom physics engine, which improved collision detection precision by 18% while maintaining stable performance across all target platforms.  

Previously, at NovaQuest Games, I designed and implemented a scalable networking framework that supported over 500 concurrent players in a battle royale title. This system reduced latency by 15% and minimized server-side computational load by 27%, allowing for smoother match experiences. My work on dynamic terrain rendering, using OpenGL and Vulkan, enabled procedural landscape generation that adapted to player movement without noticeable hitching.  

In my early career at PixelForge Interactive, I contributed to the core systems of a multiplayer survival game, refining the physics engine to handle complex interactions between environmental hazards and player mechanics. This effort improved simulation stability by 30% and reduced crash reports by 40% during live testing. I also optimized the rendering pipeline for mobile devices, achieving a 25% boost in frame rate without sacrificing visual fidelity.  

**Technical Skills**  
C#/.NET: Engine systems, scripting for game logic, and tooling development.  
Game Networking: Multiplayer synchronization, latency compensation, and server-client architecture.  
3D Graphics (OpenGL/Vulkan): Pipeline optimization, real-time lighting, and cross-platform rendering.  
Game Physics: Collision detection, rigid-body dynamics, and simulation accuracy.  
Unity: Cross-platform deployment, asset pipeline automation, and performance profiling.  

**Projects**  
- *Cross-Platform Puzzle Game (LuminaPlay Studios)*: Designed a physics-based puzzle system using custom collision detection, achieving a 22% reduction in CPU usage during complex interactions.  
- *Battle Royale Networking Framework (NovaQuest Games)*: Developed a scalable server architecture that supported 500+ players, reducing latency by 15% through predictive interpolation.  
- *Dynamic Terrain Rendering (PixelForge Interactive)*: Implemented Vulkan-based rendering for procedural landscapes, enabling real-time terrain adjustments with minimal performance overhead.  
- *Physics Engine Integration (LuminaPlay Studios)*: Engineered a modular physics system that improved collision accuracy by 18% while maintaining stable frame rates across all platforms.

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | Czech Technical University | 2017
